FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
Date: 14-06-2020
CIRCULAR
With regard to the mentioning of matters, this is to inform all
concerned that, Honourable the Chief Justice has been pleased to pass
the following further order:
“While continuing the mechanism and the instructions
issued in the order dtd 04/06/2020 and in the ‘User Guide -
Online Mentioning Platform’ dtd. 07/06/2020, it is further
ordered that the requests for mentioning of Civil matters
and of Criminal matters shall be separately entertained by
Honourable Mr. Justice R. M. Chhaya and Honourable
Ms. Justice Bela M. Trivedi, respectively, with effect from
15/06/2020.”
Sd/-
REGISTRAR GENERAL
